title: Suggest Triage Playbook
desc: Operator playbook for reviewing wkappbot suggestions: classify duplicates, prioritize by impact, keep evidence requirements explicit, and convert repeated insights into skills.
steps: PRIORITY ZERO: Check resolve before triage. Every suggest fix must end with suggest resolve TS. Do NOT skip or defer resolve. Resolve completion (HALF or RESOLVED) is the gate. Only after resolve may you move to next suggest.
Classify each item by audience: operator, developer, project, or user.
Merge obvious duplicates before fixing so one root cause does not create multiple partially solved items.
Prioritize by quick win, frequency, and risk. For large backlogs: use ask-suggest-priority-batching -- one GPT batch rank then per-item asks concurrently before acting.
Keep resolve evidence minimal: one test script, one pass condition, one note.
If a suggestion keeps reappearing, convert the recurring lesson into a skill before closing.
Prefer concise triage note: what it is, why it matters, what the next action is.

suggest merge --all-matching PATTERN --title X --work Nh: bulk-merge matching suggests (non-WKAppBot channels only, cap=20). Use --dry-run to preview. See T2 for confirm flow and delegation, T3 for guard workarounds.
author: claude
